svg.text: MPx Squeeze v1 · IISc CPDM · preliminary, not for manufacture
1. Section A-A on axis, shown closed with dust cap fitted. Flow left to right.
2. Polymers only as silicone seals (FDA 21 CFR 177.2600); no other plastic in the unit.
3. Leak test 1.5 bar air under water, 60 s, no bubbles. Bubble-point every element (ISO 4003).
4. Clean flow (grade 0.2): ~0.54 L/min at 0.3 bar squeeze; ~2.7 L/min at 1.5 bar tap.
316L bar Ø38; 28 PCO 1881 int. + M32×1 int.
316L bar Ø38; M32×1 int., M14×1.5 int., M14×1 ext.
Sintered 316L tube Ø20×2, grade 0.2 (≈1.4 µm abs. liquid)
316L twilled Dutch weave, 40 µm, Ø20 disc
316L ferrule M22×1 + silicone cone sleeve + clamp
Core unit (items 1–9 + seals) ≈ 315 g from CAD volumes. Items 10–13 are accessories, carried separately.
* Buy as a custom sintered tube from a porous-metal supplier, then weld item 5 to it (see sheet 5).
tap pressure, ~1–2 bar; open tap gently
Plastic only upstream: the PET bottle and the inlet gasket sit before the
element; downstream of it there is only 316L and silicone seals.
